title: Hades Costs You $1.06 an Hour. Worth It?
caption:
Hades is $24.99 on Steam and takes about 24 hours to beat (HowLongToBeat main story: 23.6): $1.06 an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Go 100% (about 95 hours) and it drops to 26¢ an hour. Our own math.
Which game should we price next?

Sources: Steam store (US price), HowLongToBeat
ig_first_line: Send this to the friend with 300 hours in Hades. Its main story costs $1.06 an hour.
